deviations_from_adr: FF-9 smoke-apply (npm run seed:smoke) not wired as a CI step in package.json — the smoke test requires a live Postgres DB and is gated under fitness:db. AC-7/8/9/10 are now covered by ci/checks/db/seed-pack.test.ts (R-2 resolved). The npm run seed:smoke hook as a separate CI step is not added since it would require the DB service in ambient-free CI — fitness:db is the correct gate per the ADR pattern.

GET /api/tenants/:slug and GET /api/org/tenant-state helper endpoints added (not in ADR §4) — these are importer-internal helpers required to resolve tenant UUID and current state for idempotent apply/reset. GET /api/org/tenant-state is now gated behind isGenesisOwner (R-3 resolved). Both are gated behind grantsPool (DATABASE_URL required), not accessible in no-DB path.

DELETE /api/departments|positions|employees|roles added (ADR §6 flagged these as coder-surfaced dependency for AC-9 reset delete-extra) — implemented behind isGenesisOwner gate. Now accept tenant_id in request body for correct RLS scoping (R-1 resolved).
